title: Telecaller
excerpt: Handle inbound and outbound calls to prospective students and parents.Provide accurate information about courses, admissions, and institute services.Maintain call logs and follow up with leads regularly.Support the admissions team in achieving enrollment targets.
content:
Job Description

Handle inbound and outbound calls to prospective students and parents.

Provide accurate information about courses, admissions, and institute services.

Maintain call logs and follow up with leads regularly.

Support the admissions team in achieving enrollment targets.

Requirements

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, CRM preferred).

Prior experience in telecalling/academic counseling is an added advantage.
author: Kite HR

title: Placement Coordinator
excerpt: Coordinate student placements, internships, and career support services.Guide and prepare students for interviews, group discussions, and other recruitment processes.
content:
Job Description

Build and maintain relationships with airlines, hospitality partners, and other recruiters.

Coordinate student placements, internships, and career support services.

Guide and prepare students for interviews, group discussions, and other recruitment processes.

Track placement records and prepare placement reports.

Requirements

Excellent communication and networking skills.

Strong organizational and coordination abilities.

Prior experience in placement/career services preferred.
author: Kite HR

title: Accountant
excerpt: Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including entries, invoices, and reconciliations.
content:
Job Description

Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including entries, invoices, and reconciliations.

Prepare financial statements, budgets, and expense reports.

Handle petty cash, bank transactions, and vendor payments.

Ensure compliance with accounting standards and institute policies.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

Knowledge of Tally/ERP and MS Excel.

Minimum 1–2 years of accounting experience preferred.
author: Kite HR
